name: Willem V. Rembrandt
source:
Likes: Sweets
Dislikes: Spicy foods, broccoli
Hobbies: Collecting antiques, taking care of his hair
Skills: Solving puzzles

"Why are you so beautiful?"

Hisoka: Willem V. Rembrandt is the only Dragonkin who survived the war occurred long, long time ago.
He is also well-known as a former Headmaster of this academy and one of the culprits who stole my magic watch.
I was very upset, but something about him tells me he isn't a bad guy...
That is why his late behavior is something I question about.
Well everybody is going through something...
I guess that's life.

[Official in-game description]
